headline: TTK Healthcare Q2 net profit surges on brand sale despite weak operations
hook: Asset sale masks core operational decline
summary: TTK Healthcare reported a net profit of ₹223 crore for the second quarter, up from ₹20.4 crore a year ago, driven by a ₹248.2 crore exceptional gain from selling its EVA and GoodHome brands to Wipro Enterprises. However, weak operational performance caused the stock to tank 17%. The profit surge is entirely non-recurring, masking the underlying weakness in the company's core business operations. Retail investors holding the stock face heightened volatility as core earnings fail to match headline profit figures.
why_it_matters: Headline profit hides core operational weakness, triggering a sell-off
winners_losers: Wipro gains brands / TTK shareholders hurt by weak operations

headline: Ace investor Sunil Singhania adds six stocks and likely exits two in Q2
hook: Six new bets from a market veteran
summary: Sunil Singhania’s Abakkus funds added six new stocks to its portfolio during the July-September quarter, including Aether Industries, BEML, and Paramount Communications. Amid foreign investor outflows and market volatility, the firm also likely exited Cyient DLM and TTK Healthcare following a 150% rally in the latter. Additionally, Abakkus has filed papers for an initial public offering of its own. Indian retail investors tracking marquee investor portfolios can use these filings to identify potential stock ideas and sector bets.
why_it_matters: Track marquee investor portfolio shifts for new stock ideas
winners_losers: Aether and BEML gain / Cyient DLM and TTK Healthcare hurt
